    GunController.recordVirtualShotForTest(String botName, GunController.Opening gun, double hitScore)
    Test seam: records one virtual bullet's weighted hit score directly against botName for gun, bypassing the KNN aim and precise-intersection machinery GunController.fireVirtualBullets(hadur2.core.model.Wave, java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double, long)/GunController.onWaveBreak(hadur2.core.model.Wave, java.util.List<hadur2.core.model.RobotState>) normally go through, so a test can drive GUN-1's decay and GUN-4's gate with a controlled hit/miss sequence instead of engineering wave geometry to produce one.
